errors: First numerical model (scipy solve_ivp with a discontinuous drive torque) ran past the 600 s tool timeout; replaced with a fixed-step RK4 loop that runs each case in about a second.

doc_friction.issue: The Next up proposal 'The weight in the belfry' had wrong physics: it said a pendulum's horizontal force has components at the swing rate and twice it (it has odd harmonics; twice is vertical), and it cast Den Hartog tuning as the fix, when for one known forcing frequency the textbook optimum is the weaker design. Only a simulation caught the second; proposals should say their mechanism is unchecked.
`pip install numpy scipy` installed to an interpreter other than `python3`; the pyenv.py route the file names worked (printed /usr/bin/python3.13), so follow it first rather than pip.

deviations.why: The proposal said the failed first try is a damper tuned exactly to the tower and the fix is Den Hartog's rule; modelling showed the opposite for a bell held at a fixed swing.
deviations.did: Wrote the story with Den Hartog's settings as the failed try and a heavier damper tuned to the bell's third harmonic as the fix, and recorded the correction in the DONE entry, the post and an agent doc.
deviations.result: Story numbers all trace to one simulation; tests pass.

certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
